cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to express something in words; to talk or say it
cards.Nuance (English): Used as the verbal sense of the graph in the Laozi opening, not as the noun 'Way'.
cards.Register (English): Wang Bi recension; inherited Classical Chinese
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the underlying guiding principle, order, or course that governs things
cards.Nuance (English): A capitalized or technical philosophical sense in translation is often appropriate, but the Chinese itself is a common pre-Qin abstract noun.
cards.Register (English): Wang Bi recension; philosophical Classical Chinese
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way is vast and cannot be named.|People follow the Way in their conduct.|Those who keep to the Way speak little.|To know the Way is not to contend.
cards.Sentences: 道大而不名。|人循道而行。|守道者寡言。|知道而不爭。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): a road, route, or way of passage
cards.Nuance (English): Refers to a concrete route of movement, not a doctrine or principle.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): There is a road ahead.|The cart advances along the road.|Lost on the road, he does not return.|At midnight there is no road.
cards.Sentences: 前有道。|車循道而進。|迷道不返。|夜半無道。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): a way of doing something; a procedure or technique
cards.Nuance (English): Abstracts a practical way of proceeding rather than a physical path.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Craft has its method.|Ruling the state has its method.|Learning must have a method.|Its method is very simple.
cards.Sentences: 工有道。|治國有道。|學必有道。|其道甚簡。
